data.title: Bayhorse Silver Reports Underground Drilling Results From Four IP Targets
data.description:
Bayhorse Silver ( (TSE:BHS) ) has provided an update.

Bayhorse Silver reported results from six of seven underground drill holes totaling 886 metres into four IP targets identified in its 2025 survey; results from one hole remain pending. Three holes intersected minor silver and copper values, including intervals with silver of 25.8, 15.5 and 10.6 ppm, while two CR-2 holes had no reportable results.

Drilling into CR-1 encountered relatively competent ground, while CR-2 faced extremely difficult conditions. A hole targeting the northern rhyolite body was terminated at 365 feet because of ground conditions, and structural offset and faulting prevented drilling the deeper northern segment of mineralization from the underground station.

data.title: Vitalist Extends Private-Placement Closing Deadline and Launches Reebok Kinetic
data.description:
CE Brands ( (TSE:VITA) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Vitalist received a 30-day TSX Venture Exchange extension, moving the closing deadline for its concurrent non-brokered private placements from November 27 to December 27, 2026. The offerings comprise up to C$5 million in equity units and up to C$5 million in unsecured convertible debentures, with updated debenture terms including a C$1.20 maximum conversion price and no forced conversion option.

The Reebok Kinetic smartwatch, designed and developed by Vitalist under a multiyear licensing agreement with Authentic Brands Group, is now available in Canada and the United States. It is the first commercial device built on VitalOS™, which supports third-party applications, software updates and more than five days of battery life on a single charge, according to the release.

data.title: Mixed Martial Arts Group Receives NYSE American Listing Notice
data.description:
An announcement from Mixed Martial Arts Group ( (MMA) ) is now available.

Mixed Martial Arts Group Limited, doing business as MMA.INC, reported on November 27, 2026 that it had received a November 25 letter from NYSE Regulation stating it was below NYSE American’s continued-listing standard requiring at least US$2.0 million in stockholders’ equity after losses in two of its three most recent fiscal years. The notification related to equity reported in audited financial statements as of June 30, 2026.

The company’s ordinary shares continued to trade on NYSE American, and the company said the notification had no effect on its business, operations or SEC reporting obligations. It also reported a US$4 million ordinary-share equity raising at US$1.00 per share in August 2026 and estimated annualized cash operating-cost reductions of more than US$2.51 million, including more than US$800,000 implemented between July 1 and September 28, 2026.
